extension.description: Reviews HCS Trace 0.2.0 topic inspection, live polling, full-topic scans, and exports. Covers direct executables and positional npx/npm exec package invocations, including version suffixes. Direct help narrows only the matching rule; package-launcher help retains review. The CLI reads Hedera data and can write export files locally.
extension.name: HCS Trace

permissions.description: Reviews query, decode, and topic requests to Hedera Mirror Nodes. Query can continue through additional pages, and --all removes the page prompt. Decode also fetches messages from the network.
permissions.label: HCS topic inspection
safer_guidance: Choose the intended --network and topic before fetching messages.
Use --limit to reduce the query page size or the number of messages decoded.

permissions.description: Reviews tail, which repeatedly polls a Mirror Node until interrupted. The default interval is 3000 milliseconds.
permissions.label: HCS live polling
safer_guidance: Use query or decode for a finite inspection.
Choose a suitable --interval and stop tail when inspection is complete.

permissions.description: Reviews stats and export, which scan the full topic by default, and query --all/-a. In 0.2.0, stats --sample changes the page size but still follows every page. Export writes to stdout unless --output is supplied. Filtering can require fetching more messages than the export --limit because the limit counts matching output records.
permissions.label: HCS topic scan and export
safer_guidance: Use query --limit for a smaller initial inspection; stats --sample does not bound the total scan in 0.2.0.
Use export --limit to limit output records; filters may still require scanning additional pages.
Check the destination before redirecting output or supplying --output.

permissions.description: Reviews export --output, which opens a local file for writing and can truncate an existing file before the first Mirror Node request succeeds. JSON, JSONL, and CSV formats share this behavior.
permissions.label: HCS export file output
safer_guidance: Choose a new output path or back up an existing destination before exporting.
Omit --output to write to stdout, then review any shell redirection separately.
